page.title: Fields
page.subtitle: Find a field and book a time for your next game.

filters.sheetDescription: Choose a date, sport and field type.

empty.title: No fields found
empty.description: Try changing or clearing the filters to see more results.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't load the fields. Try again in a moment.

availability.title: Availability
availability.none: There are no available times right now.
availability.emptyDay: There are no available times on this day.

new.title: Add a field
new.subtitle: Write the details in the language you're reading the page in. The translation into the other language is automatic.

location.title: Location
location.notFound: We couldn't find that address. Try a more detailed one, with a number and a city.
location.hint: Enter street, number and city, e.g. 10 Agiou Dimitriou, Ilioupoli. If the address can't be found, use the coordinates from Google Maps.
location.coordinatesHint: In Google Maps, right-click the spot and copy the two numbers shown. Paste them here. When filled in, they're used instead of the address search.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Up to {{max}} photos, {{size}} MB each. The first one is the cover.
photos.errorType: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP files are allowed.
photos.errorSize: Each photo must be {{size}} MB or smaller.
photos.errorMax: You can upload up to {{max}} photos.

new.note: The field will appear once it's approved.

errors.location: Find and pick the address first with the Find button.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.coordinates: Enter the coordinates as two numbers with a decimal point, e.g. 37.9301, 23.7611.

admin.title: Field approval
admin.subtitle: Review new fields before they go public.

PENDING.title: No pending fields
PENDING.description: When someone submits a field, you'll find it here.

APPROVED.title: No approved fields
APPROVED.description: Fields you approve will show up here.

REJECTED.title: No rejected fields
REJECTED.description: Fields you reject will show up here.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't load the fields. Try again in a moment.

actions.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The photos don't show the field.
actions.reasonHint: The owner will see it. Write it in the language you're reading the page in. It's translated automatically.
actions.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

owner.title: My fields
owner.subtitle: See the status of your fields and manage them.

card.pendingNote: It won't be public until it's approved. You can still edit it.
card.archivedNote: It's not shown anywhere. Past bookings are kept.

archive.title: Archive this field?
archive.body: The field will stop being shown. Bookings already made stay in the history.
archive.blockedOne: There is 1 upcoming booking. Archive the field once it's over or cancelled.
archive.blockedOther: There are {count} upcoming bookings. Archive the field once they're over or cancelled.
archive.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

empty.title: You don't have any fields yet
empty.description: Add your first field and send it for approval.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't load your fields. Try again in a moment.

edit.title: Edit field
edit.subtitle: Write the details in the language you're reading the page in. If you change a text, it's translated again automatically.
edit.noticeApproved: If you change texts, photos or location, the field will go through approval again and won't be shown until then. Type and sports change right away.
edit.noticeRejected: When you save, the field will be sent for approval again.

slots.title: Availability

notApproved.title: This field isn't approved yet
notApproved.description: You can set time slots once the field is approved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't load the time slots. Try again in a moment.

list.heading: Time slots for the day
list.empty: There are no time slots on this day. Add one below.

form.title: New time slot
form.errorDate: Choose today or a later date.
form.errorOrder: The end must be after the start.
form.errorPast: That start time has already passed.
form.errorPrice: Enter a valid price, e.g. 20 or 17.50.
form.errorOverlap: This time overlaps with an existing slot. Choose another time.
form.errorInvalid: This time slot can't be added. Check the details and try again.

slots.deleteConflict: This time slot can't be deleted because its status has changed.
slots.deleteError: The time slot wasn't deleted. Try again.
